title: Isolation of live bacteria from adult insects
protocol: Use autoclaved microcentrifuge tubes and gloves.
Collect 50-100 adult insects on ice with 70% EtOH.
Transfer anesthetized flies to the Centrifugal Filter.
Wash flies five times with 70% ethanol.
Spin for 5-10 seconds at 1,000 g in a tabletop microcentrifuge to remove most of the EtOH.
Wash flies three times with sterile H2O.
Spin for 5-10 seconds to eliminate most of the water.
Transfer the filter unit to a sterile microcentrifuge tube.
Spin for 3 minutes at around 10,000 g.
From 50 to 100 flies, yield is approximately 10-20 μl.
